mapping.summary: Lets sales credit memo lines credit the customer without putting stock back.
claims: Each sales credit memo line gets an inventory handling choice
Credit-only option credits customer and G/L in full with no change to on-hand stock
Write-off option tags the item journal entry type differently for inventory reporting
One action applies the same option to all lines
Options can be switched on or off per company with a company default
Changes can be blocked on lines tied to special order or drop shipment purchases
Posted credit memo shows only entered lines; the inventory offset stays in the item ledger
Separate permission sets for users and administrators
Publishes an event so other extensions can adjust the reversal line
No external services; depends only on the Base Application
BC online version 28.0 or later, Essentials or Premium
